title: Macro StoryLine — Growth, Inflation, Labor & Market Response
summary: A four-panel narrative capturing the evolving macro landscape across growth, inflation, labor conditions, and market reaction into year-end.

rows.title: Growth & Inflation — Manufacturing Softens While Dollar Pass-Through Builds
bullets: ISM Manufacturing stays in contraction while orders and employment weaken further.
Import prices turn positive as a softer USD begins to lift traded-goods inflation.
Overall: softer growth momentum paired with early-stage inflation stabilization.

rows.title: Labor & Market Reaction — Hiring Slows, Gold Breaks Higher
bullets: ADP −32k confirms private-sector hiring momentum has rolled over.
Rate expectations and a softer USD continue to reinforce precious-metals strength.
Gold’s breakout validates easing expectations and acts as a macro hedge.
